title: Customer Stories See how customers innovate with AWS data & AI
content: AWS for Data Overview Products Partners Resources Customers Data, Analytics, & AI — Customer stories See how organizations are putting their data to work with AWS How the NFL powers every play with an AI-ready data foundation From Next Gen Stats to player health and safety, AWS data and analytics services help the NFL transform 500M+ data points per season into game-changing intelligence for teams, players, and fans. Watch the AWS + NFL Next Gen Stats series Play Building an open data foundation for agentic success See how customers are building open, scalable, and secure data foundations to get the most out of agentic AI. Data Migration Building Agentic AI Apps Search and Vector Iceberg Open Data Architecture Boosting customer experience by migrating to Amazon RDS for SQL Server iCIMS migrated nearly 6,000 databases to Amazon RDS for SQL Server with no business disruptions and a total downtime of less than 4 hours. The move has improved performance, lowered operational overhead, and given employees more time to work on value-added tasks. Read the case study Making data ready for agentic innovation Autodesk’s agentic AI platform, Autodesk Assistant, enables natural language interactions across its product suite, reducing manual work from hours to minutes and allowing architects, engineers, and designers to focus on creativity. See how they did it with Amazon Bedrock, EKS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, and Apache Iceberg. Read the case study Play Unlocking insights from petabytes of data with agentic search BMW Group empowers employees to search petabytes of data using natural language—no SQL or dedicated vector database needed. With its agentic search solution on Amazon S3 Vectors, Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore, BMW enables data-driven insights from 110 TB of data ingested daily. Read the blog Play Using Iceberg and AI to power autonomous investigation at scale CyberArk cut case resolution time by up to 95% and boosted engineer productivity 4x—with zero manual intervention. By combining Iceberg's intelligent metadata management with Amazon Bedrock automation, diverse support logs from hundreds of vendor formats become queryable the instant they land.
